title: EXIT
captionPendingSweep: An earlier exit package finished, but some sats are still onchain waiting for the final recovery sweep.
captionPreparedPackage: A prepared exit package is on this device. Continue runs it in the background through all bumps, CSV waits, and sweeps.
captionIdle: Last resort if the Arkade operator is down or uncooperative. Start a unilateral exit when you need to sweep to your recovery address without the operator.
captionWaitingCsv: Unilateral exit is waiting for the onchain CSV timelock. Cards show blocks left and a time estimate. You can leave this screen; progress continues in the background.
captionBroadcasting: Unilateral exit is broadcasting and confirming onchain transactions. You can leave this screen; progress continues in the background.
captionPaused: Unilateral exit paused. Tap Resume on a card to continue, or Start another unilateral exit for new funds.
pendingSweepBody: Your last exit package already finished, but %{sats} sats (%{count} output%{plural}) still sit onchain after the CSV unroll. They are not at your recovery address yet. Tap below to broadcast the final sweep.
openWalletVtxos: Open wallet to refresh local VTXOs
switchArkadeHint: Switch to an Arkade (seed) wallet to exit.
packageFinishedPartial: This package only swept part of your funds. Use the Remaining onchain card (~%{sats} sats).
packageFinishedFull: This exit already swept its package onchain. Prepare a new package if offchain VTXOs remain.
sweepBroadcastBody:
Swept %{sats} sats to recovery (%{count} output%{plural}).
Tx %{txid}…
recoveryWizardCaption:
Where exited funds should land: an address from an external Bitcoin wallet you control.

After you start unilateral exit, Basic unrolls your VTXOs onchain, then a CSV locktime must expire before the sweep can pay this address. That wait is normal (ASP unilateralExitDelay; often tens of minutes on Mutinynet, longer on mainnet). Progress and the remaining lock show on the Exit screen.

You do not need to sit and wait. After Start execute, keep using Basic as usual: receive, send, and board new funds. The exit continues in the background and finishes when the lock clears.
recoveryCaption: External Bitcoin address for unilateral exit. Funds land here after onchain unroll and the CSV locktime. You can keep using the wallet normally once exit has started; you do not have to wait on this screen.
recoveryWarn: Do not use an Arkade boarding address (the onchain address you use to deposit into Arkade). Boarding is for entering Arkade; recovery must be a different wallet.
savedWizardBody: Next: review the exit package. Auto-prepare may already have one ready (or will build it while the operator is reachable).
savedBody: Basic will auto-prepare an exit package in the background when your Arkade balance changes.
clearedBody: Recovery address cleared. Auto-prepare is paused.
setRecoveryStep1: Set a recovery address in step 1 first.
packageReadyContinue: Auto-prepare saved a package for your current balance. Continue to fund fees.
packageBuilding: Auto-prepare is building or updating the package. Wait a moment, or estimate manually.
skippedVtxos: %{sats} sats in skipped VTXOs (not in this exit)
onlyLatestPackage: Only the latest package is kept. Auto-prepare replaces it when your balance changes.
hintReady: Recover amount is after sweep fees; skipped uneconomic VTXOs stay listed in the package.
hintPrepare: Prepare does not spend fee sats. You fund the fee address only in step 3.
estimateFailedBody: Could not quote exit (indexer may be down).
noPackageStep2: No stored package. Complete step 2 first.
fundCaption: This address is derived from your Arkade seed — it is yours. Send onchain sats here so Basic can pay miner fees when executing.
mismatchRecovered: Stored package recovers ~%{stored} sats, but prepare reported ~%{expected}. A background auto-prepare may have overwritten it — go back and prepare again.
mismatchFunding: Fee need on disk ~%{stored} vs prepare ~%{expected}.
fundWarn: Fund from an external wallet. When the balance covers the need, continue to Start execute (step 4).
noPackageSteps: No stored package. Complete steps 1–3 first.
executeCaption: Starts the stored package onchain in the background. You can leave the exit screens; progress continues until Stop or completion.
underfundedWarn: Fee address is underfunded. Go back to step 3 and send sats before starting.
fundFeesFirstBody: Go back to step 3 and fund your fee address before Start execute.
collabCaption:
Exit to an external Bitcoin address while the Arkade operator can settle a batch. Prefer this over unilateral exit when the service is healthy.

There is no unilateral CSV locktime on this path: you and the operator cosign, so funds leave Arkade without waiting for the emergency timelock. (That CSV delay applies only to unilateral exit.)
withdrawFailedBody: Operator may be unreachable. Try unilateral exit.
csvFetchingTip: Fetching chain tip for blocks remaining…
csvSweepNextPoll: Sweep can broadcast on the next poll
csvNoDetails: Timelock details not in event yet
